scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Persons Suffering from Rare Diseases
other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile and bonafide resident of Haryana
Applicant must possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra
Applicant must be suffering from a Rare Disease listed in the National Policy for Rare Diseases, 2021 and diagnosed at a designated Centre of Excellence
benefits_summary: Eligible patients receive a monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000.
